title: Run real-records status criteria before the verifier and record evidence
summary: After the producer's report and before the verifier, Athena runs each behavior criterion that gives a `status --snapshot` command against the evidence snapshot and records the command and its output as evidence for the producer and verifier. A constant measure or an out-of-range value is sent back to the producer; an unreachable snapshot ends the job early with that reason. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier, who stop seeing these jobs fail at the final verdict.

defaults_applied.how: A criterion checks that a status-measure job is stopped or sent back before the verifier, not just that code exists.
Fake-producer test plus fmt, clippy and test criteria.
CHANGELOG.md entry and doc comments written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs (producer_loop: report, format_stage, change_list, loop_replay, loop_check_failures, then break to the verifier; send-backs via PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS and problems/send_back_text), crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (the evidence snapshot is written at ~line 1153 via crate::snapshot::evidence_dir and substituted into the producer brief), crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs (`athena status --snapshot <dir>` reads it with no repository), crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs and reading.rs (the real-records criterion text), crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs and crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs (fake producer). Run order: producer report, format, self-checks, then the new records-criteria run, then verifier. The measure is read directly from the command's printed output on the snapshot. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are untouched unless a new record kind is chosen, which is not planned; the output is kept as check evidence in the existing form.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs (evidence_dir, write, status over a snapshot dir), crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs (loop_check_failures, append_check_failures, send-back text) and run/checks.rs (check evidence the verifier sees); the change extends these rather than adding a parallel path.

Selection: a behavior criterion whose text contains `status --snapshot` with an evidence directory; Athena runs it from its own process on the evidence snapshot directory, not inside the producer sandbox.

Same answer for every item means the measure's printed per-item values are all identical when there is more than one item; the stated range is parsed from the criterion text. If the range cannot be parsed, the output is recorded and shown but does not send back.

Environment: reads the local evidence snapshot directory Athena writes per job (read-only copy of records/, landings/ and main first-parent history); no network, push, PR or CI. `Snapshot unreachable from the producer's workspace` means the path is missing or not readable by the producer's grant; then the job ends early with that reason via self.failure.
Send-backs reuse the existing PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS budget; after it is spent the failure reaches the verifier as a flagged gap, like check failures.
Field meaning: no existing field, CLI argument or config key is reused; new behavior uses existing status --snapshot CLI as documented in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs:28.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new fake-producer test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs: a reading with a `status --snapshot` behavior criterion whose measure is constant across items is sent back to the producer before the verifier runs, and the recorded evidence holds the command and its output. Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and name the test.

A fake-producer test shows a measure inside the stated range passes: the command and output are recorded as evidence in the verifier's brief and the verifier then runs. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

A fake-producer test shows a measure outside the stated range is sent back, and an unreachable snapshot ends the job early with a reason that names the snapshot, before any verifier invocation. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs (or a new run module it calls) runs the criterion after loop_check_failures and before `break Some(report)`, in Athena's own process, and the diff shows the command and output added to the evidence the producer's send-back and the verifier's brief carry.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing the pre-verifier real-records run, its send-back conditions and the early end when the snapshot is unreachable.
If a new appended decision is added to docs/decisions.md it has a Provenance bullet; no existing entry or anything under records/ is edited.
No unrelated behavior changes: criteria that name no real records run nothing new, and the existing tests pass. Run `cargo test`.

out_of_scope: Changing the check_records_measure reading gate or its wording in reading/surveys.rs
Editing existing entries in docs/decisions.md or anything under records/
Running criteria that do not name real records (fixture-only criteria)
departures: A hard pipeline change in a large file (run/producer.rs) plus a new fake-producer scenario and possible brief edits raises cost and time over the reference.
urgent_reason: It cuts failed jobs and verifier rejections at the final verdict, which are repeated redo-work (five failures, class 20261111-105030-a2bc).
hard_reason: It changes the run pipeline between producer and verifier and adds a rule that sends work back or ends a job early.
